text: Bit of a long night here so apologies if this is a waste of your time. I'm fostering a 6 yr old boy, he's had a sore throat since yesterday and his temp was 38.5 tonight. He's still drinking ok though I think it hurts a bit. Once the ibuprofen kicks in he's playing with his cars and chatting away, it's just when it wears off the temp creeps back up. He's wide awake now, watching telly, answering me properly. I checked his neck too, he can look right down at his tummy no bother. I'm fairly sure he's ok really, I just wanted to check I'm not missing anything because I'm shattered and not thinking straight
